title: Retrospective meningiomas RNA-sequencing data.

publications.title: Molecular classification to refine surgical and radiotherapeutic decision-making in meningioma.

patient_count: Not reported (384 samples per series; retrospective multicentre cohort, patient count not separately stated)
needs_manual_review_reason: PUBLICATION RESOLVED (2026-07-11): a previous plausible-looking candidate (PMID 42143623, 'Modern molecular profiling recontextualizes the NRG/RTOG-0539 trial...', same senior authors Nassiri and Zadeh) was checked directly and ruled out, that paper describes a distinct, smaller (n=100) trial cohort, not this retrospective series. A different candidate, PMID 39169220 ('Molecular classification to refine surgical and radiotherapeutic decision-making in meningioma,' Nature Medicine, published 2024-08-21, exactly matching this series' own 'Public on' date), was found via a Europe PMC full-text search for the literal accession strings 'GSE270638' and 'GSE270375', which returned this paper as an explicit hit, confirming it actually cites this dataset in its full text (not just a topical/authorship guess). Author list independently confirmed to include both Nassiri F and Zadeh G (Zadeh as final/senior author, matching this record's corresponding_author field exactly). Abstract describes a large retrospective cohort (2,824 meningiomas, 1,686 with molecular data) that separately incorporates the RTOG-0539 trial (~100 prospective patients) as one validation component, consistent with this being the larger umbrella study distinct from the smaller RTOG-0539-only paper already ruled out. publication_status left 'normal' (no retraction/correction found on this PMID via PubMed esummary). verification_tier upgraded from 2 to 1 and found_via extended to include citation_chain, since the publication is now independently corroborated via a second search method beyond the original keyword_api discovery of the accession. FACT-CHECK (2026-07-10): sample_count was wrongly copied from the paired methylation series (994) instead of this series' own count; the live GEO record for GSE270638 lists exactly 384 Series_sample_id entries (confirmed 994 + 384 = 1378, matching the GSE270375 superseries total), corrected to 384. tissue_preservation corrected from 'fresh_frozen' to 'both': although the series summary says 'fresh-frozen samples', individual GSM records (e.g. GSM8348767) state RNA was extracted 'from a combination of fresh frozen and paraffin-embedded tissue'. title corrected to add the trailing period present in the live Series_title. date_deposited corrected to the actual Series_submission_date (Jun 24 2024); the prior value (2024-08-21) was actually the 'Public on' date, not the submission date. FACT-CHECK (2026-07-11): corresponding_author reformatted from 'Farshad Nassiri / Gelareh Zadeh' to 'Farshad,,Nassiri, Gelareh,,Zadeh' -- same two people (independently re-confirmed as the paper's only two true corresponding authors via PMC full text PMC11564112, author-notes emails farshad.nassiri@uhn.ca and gelareh.zadeh@uhn.ca), just reformatted to match this corpus's standard GEO-contributor-string convention (comma-separated 'Last,MI,First' pairs) used elsewhere, and to now be textually identical to the sibling gse-270371-methylation.json record's corrected corresponding_author field. COMPLETENESS FIX (2026-07-12): source_urls was missing the PubMed link for the resolved publication (PMID 39169220), even though this record's publications array cites it and the reason field extensively documents its verification; added https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39169220/. ACCESSION ADDED (2026-07-13), prompted by a user question about whether a different paper's (Landry et al. 2026) data-availability statement, which reuses this cohort's data, was fully cross-referenced here: fetched PMID 39169220's own full-text data-availability section directly and confirmed it states 'Unprocessed RNA sequencing data (FASTQ) are deposited in the NCBI Sequence Read Archive... under the project number PRJNA1127224 for the retrospective meningiomas' -- i.e. PRJNA1127224 is the raw-FASTQ SRA mirror of this exact GSE270638 cohort, not a separate dataset.
